newsitem.title: UK: NWE spot naphtha steady, swaps firm with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE spot naphtha steady, swaps firm with crude.

text.p: NWE spot naphtha prices held steady but talked in a wide range with buyers relaxed and offers scarce, traders said.
Petrochemical companies were thought to be fairly well stocked through to mid-January and slack European gasoline demand has muted demand from reformers.
However, traders said healthier U.S. gasoline demand may draw some heavy naphtha transatlantic.
Spot cargo bids were pegged around $216 with offers at $220 both were notional. Swaps held firm with crude. January contracts were valued around $223.
